slot_oid=0 OR slot_name_length <> slot_length-9 OR slot_oid=ANY(slot_oids)

SELECT r.oid,r.rolname,r.rolcanlogin,r.rolinherit,r.rolsuper,r.rolcreaterole,
               r.rolcreatedb,r.rolreplication,r.rolbypassrls
                             FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE r.oid::pg_catalog.int8=slot_oid AND r.rolname=slot_name

NOT FOUND OR NOT caller_record.rolcanlogin OR caller_record.rolinherit
           OR caller_record.rolsuper OR caller_record.rolcreaterole OR caller_record.rolcreatedb
           OR caller_record.rolreplication OR caller_record.rolbypassrls
           OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members m
                      WHERE m.member=caller_record.oid OR m.roleid=caller_record.oid)
